column1: # Replaces min_spiffs.csv for [env:esp32c5] only: the audit firmware outgrew
# and dual OTA was already unusable there (no ota_1/ota_2 to switch to).
# nvs / otadata / spiffs / coredump keep the min_spiffs offsets and sizes
# existing settings and SPIFFS data survive a reflash; only the unused second
# app slot (0x1F0000-0x3CFFFF) is merged into app0.
# NOTE: keep this file ASCII-only (PlatformIO parses it with the system codec).
